sourceContext.originPage: WKND adventure detail page (Bali Surf Camp)

contentPattern.structure: label | value per row (no-header 2-column spec table)

suitableFor: adventure/trip specification fact-sheets (activity, trip length, group size, difficulty, price, etc.)
any label/value key-fact list rendered as a compact spec sheet

similarityEvaluation.reason: No existing table-based variant in the project (scanned blocks/: existing custom variants are cards-*, carousel-*, columns-*, hero-*, accordion-faq, quote-pull, share-story — none model a label/value fact sheet). The adventure details fact-sheet is genuinely new adventure-specific structure with no existing equivalent. Best similarity 0, below threshold, so a new variant was created from the vanilla Block Collection table (no-header, 2-column).

usage.notes: doc (non-xwalk) project: moveInstrumentation import/call removed (not exported by scripts/scripts.js here). JS is otherwise the vanilla table decorator. Intended for the 'no-header' variant so the first row is data; CSS renders each row as a label-above-value spec card with a WKND yellow left-accent border. Header/striped/bordered base styles retained for graceful fallback.
